cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/workspace/submission/protocols.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""_PARSE_ERRORS = (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError,
                 OverflowError, RecursionError, struct.error)
                 plistlib.InvalidFileException)""",
"""_PARSE_ERRORS = (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, AttributeError,

sed -n '12,20p' protocols.py && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import protocols, plistlib, struct, base64
p=protocols.send_connect()
print('connect', len(p), protocols.read_adb_response(p))
s=protocols.get_value_request('ProductVersion')+protocols.get_value_request('ProductName')
print('sync', len(s), protocols.read_sync_response(s))
print('probe adb', protocols.probe_script('adb'))
print('probe sync', protocols.probe_script('sync'))
print(protocols.signature('adb', p[:-1]), protocols.signature('adb', p+b'x'))
print(protocols.signature('tcp', b''), protocols.signature('tcp', b'x'))
bad=bytearray(p); bad[24]^=0xff
print('badck', protocols.signature('adb', bytes(bad)))
auth=protocols.adb_packet(0x48545541, 5, 6, b'abc')
print('sig auth', protocols.signature('adb', auth))
for bad in [b'', b'\x00'*8, struct.pack('>I',0), struct.pack('>I',5)+b'hello',
            protocols.get_value_request('ProductVersion')]:
    print('badsync', repr(bad[:12]), protocols.signature('sync', bad))
v=plistlib.dumps({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'9'})
print('shape', protocols.signature('sync', struct.pack('>I',len(v))+v))
v2=plistlib.dumps({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'9','Extra':'x'})
print('shape2', protocols.signature('sync', struct.pack('>I',len(v2))+v2))
# binary plist
v3=plistlib.dumps({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'iPhone'}, fmt=plistlib.FMT_BINARY)
v4=plistlib.dumps({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'17.0'}, fmt=plistlib.FMT_BINARY)
print('bin', protocols.read_sync_response(struct.pack('>I',len(v4))+v4+struct.pack('>I',len(v3))+v3))
EOF
